cases: All 13 frozen R1 cells; B and C one new response each in alternating order.
B: Exact prior R1 Actor request: original prefix plus frozen Broad Plan plus frozen Qualification Card.
C: Identical original prefix plus one resolved card; no Broad Plan, status label or unpromoted D# in the added card.
promotion: no_target/hypothesis_only -> none; inspectable -> reviewed candidate handle. This is a source-for-gap judgment, never final-answer correctness.
gap_action_alignment: Single-reviewer prefix-only assessment from frozen gap, current prefix and tool arguments: yes/partial/no/unclear. A cell is directly aligned if at least one call is yes; partial is reported separately. Paired gate counts changes in directly aligned cells. Report per-call, per-cell and first-call separately. No future or result text.
candidate_inspection: Find(D#) or Open(W# mapped to D#). In hypothesis_only, unpromoted candidate inspection is counted regardless of whether it might be a falsification attempt; separately score gap alignment.
promoted_utilization: In inspectable, any Find/Open of the promoted D or its visible W, with first-call separately.
unsupported_repetition: Query/window chiefly revisits a fact already supported by prefix without testing a missing prerequisite.
search_appropriateness: Search is appropriate when its query addresses the frozen verification gap, even if an old D exists; generic re-search solely for an already supported fact is not.
success_gate: At least two paired hypothesis-only cells reduce unpromoted inspection, fewer than two countervailing; no net inspectable utilization loss; at least two net paired Gap Action Alignment improvements; no generic Search-only explanation.
failure: Provider, schema and harness errors kept separately; zero SDK retries, no selective reruns, no tool execution.
